a5.rule: For each pair, over the reference's non-truncated `ok` cells of `T-A1-<group>-full`: p25 and p50 (nearest rank, integer) of its `search.quotes_executed` (positive values only) become two `max_quotes` budgets, and of its `candidates_considered` (positive values only) two `max_candidates` budgets. A budget run replaces only that one `budget` key of the pair's A1 profile (the other stays as in the 0.2.1 budget); reference and bounded run in the same invocation. Reported separately under `not_exact_budget_binding`, never as exactness evidence.
